blurb: An `embed` compiles a file's text into the program as a `String`, so the file must exist when the project is built, or there is nothing to compile in. The path is relative to the project root and must name a regular file under `embeds/`; a symbolic link is not followed. Create the file, or correct the path. A file that exists but cannot be read is `bynk.embed.unreadable_file`.
example:
embed shell = "embeds/page.html"        // ✗ no such file in the project
embed shell = "embeds/page.html"        // ✓ once embeds/page.html exists
summary: An `embed` names a file that is not in the project's `embeds/` folder.
